$comment: Cross-module parity fixture for the env-namespaced, path-hash step-cache layout (issues 012 + 027 + 028). The CANONICAL helpers live in src/cache/step-cache.ts and are MIRRORED verbatim in testbench-native/src/extension/cache-paths.ts. Both must produce the `expected` outputs below for every row. The root vitest suite (tests/cache-dir-parity.test.ts) asserts the src helpers against this table; the extension suite (testbench-native/tests/cache-dir-parity.test.js) asserts the mirror against the SAME table. Any drift between the two modules breaks 'clear cache for this test' and is caught here. Inputs use forward-slash paths so basename/extname/relative and the normalized identity are OS-stable; do not hand-edit `expected` — regenerate from the canonical helpers.

rows.name: env 'default' literal collapses to the same segment as no-env
dev env, same file → same dir name, different segment
same basename, admin dir → MUST differ from auth (same-title collision killed)
projectRoot null → hash over the raw (absolute-ish) path, differs from relative
long basename capped at 60 chars before the hash
empty-normalizing basename (no [a-z0-9]) → hash only, no leading hyphen (idempotency edge)
separator at the 60-char cap → trailing hyphen stripped, no double hyphen at the join (idempotency edge)
